Group Risk Management Policy

GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

## 14. Key risk indicators and monitoring

## 14.1 Purpose and design standards

Keyriskindicators provide a forward-looking viewofhowexposure is changing between assessmentcycles.Theyprompt actionbefore arisk crystallises,ratherthanconfirming after the event that it has.

| REQUIREMENT | STANDARD |
|---|---|
| Relevance | Each indicator maps to at leastone risk in the Group RiskRegisterand to the appetite measure it supports. |
| Measurability | Derived from a defined,auditable datasource with a documentedcalculation.Manually compiled indicators reguirea documentedpreparation andreview control. |
| Predictive value | Leadingindicators are preferred.Laggingindicators are permittedbutmustbebalancedbyat leastoneleading indicatorfor the same risk. |
| Thresholds | Green,amber andred thresholds defined in advance,approvedby theriskowner,changed onlywith second-line agreement. |
| Ownership | Anamedowner is responsibleforproduction,accuracy andcommentary. |
| Actionability | Each indicator has a defined response for amber and red status.An indicator with no defined response is removed. |

14.2 Monitoring intensity by residual rating

| RESIDUAL RATING | KRIREPORTING | KEYCONTROLTESTING | INDEPENDENTASSURANCE |
|---|---|---|---|
| Critical | Weekly | Monthly, independent | Targeted audit within 6months |
| High | Monthly | Quarterly, independent | Included in the annual audit plan |
| Elevated | Monthly | Semi-annual | Risk-based;considered inplan |
| Moderate | Quarterly | Annual, self-testing permitted | Cyclicalcoverage |

## 14.3Breachresponse

An indicator moving to amber requires commentary from the owner explaining the movement, expected direction of travel and any action taken. Moving to red requires a documented action plan within five business days and escalation per Section 19. An indicator red for three consecutive periods must be escalated to the Group Executive Risk Committee with et assessment of whether the underlying risk rating remains appropriate.
